tools.name: google_search
tools.description: Search live Google web results for any query and country/language, returning ranked canonical organic results (position, title, direct URL, domain, snippet, favicon, sitelinks), native related_keywords array, People Also Ask (PAA) Q&A pairs, and Knowledge Graph. Cost: 6 Credits / call ($0.50–$0.75/1

tools.name: google_trends_realtime
tools.description: Retrieve real-time trending Google searches for any country, including search volume tiers (e.g. "50000+"), breakout status, and clustered news context. Cost: 6 Credits / call ($0.50–$0.75/1K; 0 Credits on 4xx/5xx error).

tools.name: google_trends_interest
tools.description: Fetch the 54-week historical Google Trends Interest Over Time curve (0–100 normalized weekly points), YoY velocity %, peak week, and multi-keyword comparison (up to 5 comma-separated keywords). Cost: 10 Credits / call ($0.83–$1.25/1K; 0 Credits on 4xx/5xx error).

tools.name: google_news_search
tools.description: Search live Google News articles by keyword, company, or ticker with publisher metadata, favicon, publication UTC timestamp, and article snippet. Cost: 6 Credits / call ($0.50–$0.75/1K; 0 Credits on 4xx/5xx error).

tools.name: google_news_top
tools.description: Retrieve breaking Google News top headlines by topic (TECHNOLOGY, BUSINESS, WORLD, NATION, SCIENCE, HEALTH, SPORTS, ENTERTAINMENT) and country. Cost: 6 Credits / call ($0.50–$0.75/1K).

tools.name: google_autocomplete
tools.description: Expand a seed keyword into real-time Google Search autocomplete suggestions for SEO keyword research, query fan-out, and agent query expansion. Cost: 1 Credit / call ($0.10/1K; 0 Credits on 4xx/5xx error).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
